newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 2.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.

President Jiang Zemin delivers New Year's speech to Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference pledging further economic reform and welcoming ideas from Taiwanese people on reunification with the mainland.
Jiang Zemin speaks to officials of non-communist parties

China Securities Regulatory Commission chief Zhou Daojiong says newly listed firms must standardise their operations, not buy and sell their company shares and must use funds raised in accordance with the public offer statement.
China predicts a slight surplus of wheat and a stable market and says fall in world prices in 1997 will create a favourable environment for wheat imports.
